**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — § 21.1**

The liability cap is mutual in form but fails the fallback on two material terms:

1. **Cap basis far too low** — one month of Fees "actually paid" versus the fallback of 12 months' fees; this is below even the six-month walk-away floor, and "Fees" (§ 1.5) excludes implementation charges, shrinking the base further. Against the § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment of USD 2,000,000/year, the cap is effectively illusory.
2. **"Without exception"** — this drags the Excluded Claims defined in § 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) inside the cap, contradicting § 21.2 and putting indemnities under the cap with no super-cap — express walk-away territory.

§§ 21.2–21.4 already match our preferred position (mutual consequential exclusion, direct-damage list including data restoration and incident response, full carve-out set, payment obligations excluded from "damages"), so the redline is confined to § 21.1: greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual, with Excluded Claims restored outside the cap. Redline validated (ok:true).
